en.headline: Most districts about two degrees cooler after monsoon arrival
en.dek: The Observatory said a northeast monsoon linked to a cold front is on the coast, with Monday between 25 and 31 degrees and no warning in force.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a northeast monsoon associated with a cold front was affecting the Guangdong coast on Monday morning, and that temperatures in most parts of Hong Kong were about two degrees lower than on Sunday morning.

The Observatory forecast Monday's range at 25 to 31 degrees. It expected the urban minimum to fall to about 23 degrees on Tuesday and Wednesday, with the New Territories another two to three degrees cooler, RTHK reported.

No weather warning was in force early on Monday. The Observatory's warning page listed none in effect after Sunday night's amber rainstorm warning, which was issued at 8:20pm and cancelled at 10:30pm.

zh.headline: 東北季候風影響沿岸 今早大部分地區低約兩度
zh.dek: 天文台表示，與冷鋒相關的東北季候風正影響廣東沿岸，星期一氣溫約25至31度，清晨沒有天氣警告生效。
body: 香港天文台表示，與冷鋒相關的東北季候風星期一早上正影響廣東沿岸，本港大部分地區氣溫較星期日早上低約兩度。
天文台預測星期一氣溫介乎25至31度，並預計星期二及星期三市區最低氣溫降至約23度，新界再低兩至三度。港台引述天文台作出報道。
星期一清晨沒有天氣警告生效。天文台警告網頁在星期日晚上的黃色暴雨警告取消後，並無列出任何生效警告。黃雨警告於晚上8時20分發出，晚上10時30分取消。
